title: Account Manager - Digital Marketing
description:
Account Manager Digital Marketing

Location: Hybrid with 2 days per week in our Altrincham office
Salary: £35,000 to £40,000 dependent on experience
Contract: Full time, Permanent

Dark Horse is a renowned digital marketing agency based in Altrincham, specialising in PPC, Paid Social, SEO and Digital PR. With a diverse clientele and a commitment to delivering exceptional results.

We re after someone who cannot stand a missed deadline, takes pride in keeping every account on track, and genuinely gives a toss about clients getting the results they were promised.

This is a hybrid role based in Altrincham. No remote applications.

What s on offer

We think we ve built a great place to work, where every individual feels rewarded for the effort they put in.
- Salary of £35,000 to £40,000 DOE
- Hybrid working - 2 days a week in office
- Flexitime
- 27 days annual leave
- Plus your Birthday off
- Mental Wellbeing Bupa EAP programme
- Leafy Altrincham location
- Dark Horse will carbon offset your role with The Dark Forest
- Working in an amazing team with many fantastic people

The role

Reporting directly to the Head of Client Services and giving them a clear view of where your accounts stand. Our Service Leads own the day-to-day client conversations and channel strategy.

You are the one making sure the results are making a tangible impact; monitoring every KPI, keeping our health scoring and check-in cadence running like clockwork, and making sure nothing ever slips between us and the client.

This is a client guardianship and relationship role, not project management or day-to-day contact.

Throughout each month you will:
- Work with the Service Leads to monitor performance against KPIs across 40 accounts
- Pressure-test our monthly reports vs KPIs, coordinating feedback across channel specialists
- Spot channel specific comms and changes that affect other areas and make sure no-one is working in a silo
- Ensure all accounts get timely performance reviews, QBRs, prebreak and pre-renewal reviews
- Maintain accurate client health scores in (url removed)
- Spot amber and red movement before it becomes a problem and escalate fast
- Support renewals and cross-sell execution (materials, follow-up) without owning the commercial strategy or pricing

In order to be successful in this role you must have / be:
- Capable of having mature commercial conversations with business owners
- Experience in client services or account management, ideally in a performance or digital marketing agency
- Calm and organised managing a high volume of accounts (40-50 contracts)
- A confident, clear and humble communicator, written and verbal
- Comfortable asking and answering the hard commercial questions with senior client stakeholders
- Data-literate: you read performance metrics (CPA, spend, conversions) and understand the commercial story behind them

It would be great if you had:
- Hands-on exposure to PPC, Paid Social, SEO or Digital PR
- Experience working alongside specialist delivery teams
- Familiarity with (url removed) and with health-scoring or account tiering frameworks

This is a hybrid role based in Altrincham. No remote applications.

If you feel you have the necessary skills and experience to be successful in this role click on APPLY !

title: Social Value Wellbeing Coordinator
description:
Our client is a well-established and growing rail and civil engineering contractor with a strong presence across the Northeast and surrounding regions. Delivering a mixture of rail, civil engineering and renewables projects, the business has built an excellent reputation for quality and sustainable growth.

Role Overview

This role leads the delivery and evidencing of the organisation's Social Value commitments, alongside business-wide wellbeing, sustainability and compliance support. It combines stakeholder engagement, internal and external communications, reporting, and office and event coordination, and works closely with senior management and the Health & Safety function.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead and coordinate the organisation's Social Value strategy, ensuring commitments are delivered and evidenced across projects and business activities.
- Manage and promote employee volunteering initiatives, including identifying opportunities, coordinating participation, and recording outcomes.
- Build and maintain relationships with community groups, charities, educational establishments, and other external stakeholders.
- Track, measure, and report on social value activities, volunteering hours, sustainability targets, and associated business benefits.
- Support internal communication campaigns to increase employee engagement in social value, wellbeing, sustainability, and compliance initiatives.
- Lead on business-wide wellbeing initiatives and support H&S with Occupational Health and EAP programmes.
- Support Health & Safety initiatives by maintaining compliance calendars, monitoring key actions, and assisting with the implementation of H&S strategies.
- Support sustainability and ESG (Environmental, Social and Governance) objectives through data collection, reporting, and the promotion of best practices.
- Lead, create and schedule engaging social media content to showcase the brand, including its achievements, community engagement activities, and company initiatives.
- Maintain and update corporate document templates, ensuring compliance with branding guidelines and company standards.
- Coordinate event planning and logistics, including venue bookings, travel arrangements, accommodation reservations, and attendee management.
- Assist with the preparation of reports, presentations, and communications relating to social value, sustainability, compliance, and business performance.

Additional Support (Could Assist With)
- Maintain accurate records and databases relating to office administration, social value activities, training, and compliance requirements.
- Provide ad hoc administrative and organisational support to senior management and wider business teams as required.
- Provide comprehensive administrative support to the business, ensuring the effective day-to-day operation of the office.
- Manage office compliance processes and records, ensuring documents remain accurate, up to date, and audit-ready.

About Global:

Established in 2001, Global has become a market leader and trusted recruitment partner in its chosen sectors. Delivering a tailored recruitment service to candidates and clients alike, Global works in a diverse range of industry sectors, supplying recruitment services and staffing solutions across Construction, Logistics, Rail, Industrial, and Engineering. Recruitment business acting on behalf clients nationwide.

If you believe you have the required skills, please apply by submitting your cv.
